title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Six-keyword rotation against We Work Remotely, region eligibility confirmed from each posting's own detail page (the site's generic 'Anywhere in the World' tag is not trustworthy on its own).
latest_update: Checked September 22, 2026 — all 6 mandatory queries run (2 zero-result, 4 with results); every result was either a known/duplicate posting already tracked from the 2026-09-21 run or clearly out of the SRE/Platform/DevOps family by title. Zero new eligible postings, zero new filings.

rows.title: Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: Customer-facing CI/CD/DevOps implementation role — direct overlap with Marc's Artifactory/CI-CD consulting background. None material.

rows.title: Professional Services DevOps Engineer
rows.location: "Open to remote within the East Coast only" — explicit US East Coast region restriction, stated at the top of the full posting; excludes Canada. Distinct from JFrog's Senior req (already Applied), which is explicitly Canada-GeoLocked.
rows.gap: Same customer-facing CI/CD/DevOps profile as JFrog's Senior req Marc already applied to, but this req's own posting text restricts remote work to the US East Coast — not take-able from Ontario.

rows.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
rows.location: Remote — EU, US, Canada, UK, Australia, Singapore (freelance marketplace, no visa assistance)
rows.gap: Requires 3+ years Kubernetes and Python/Golang — Marc has no Golang experience and his Kubernetes depth is provisioning-level, not the deep administration this listing implies. Resurfaced 2026-09-22 (still listed, 29d old at check time); also a cross-board duplicate of the 2026-08-25 RemoteOK filing, which is already marked Skipped/expired in applications.md — not refiled.

rows.title: Senior Platform Engineer
rows.location: Remote, Anywhere in the World (client engagement via Proxify)
rows.gap: Requires expert-level Kubernetes operator/controller development plus strong Go or Python for building custom platform tooling — beyond Marc's provisioning-level Kubernetes depth (CKA in progress, not complete) and he has no Go experience.

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure)
rows.location: CET timezone ±3hrs only — explicitly excludes other timezones despite the "Anywhere in the World" region tag
rows.gap: Full posting states "we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other timezones" outside CET±3 — excludes Canada/Eastern entirely. Real Azure/Terraform/AKS fit otherwise, but not take-able.

rows.title: Cloud Security Engineer
rows.gap: Cloud-security specialist role (threat detection, security architecture ownership) rather than DevOps, Platform, or SRE center of gravity.

rows.title: AI Engineer - FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)
rows.gap: Application-layer GenAI/customer-solutions engineering role, not infrastructure or DevOps work — title only nominally matches the Forward Deployed Engineer search term.

notes_sections.heading: Per-query audit — 2026-09-22
items: DevOps Engineer: 9 results, reviewed. Complete. In-family hits: JFrog Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer (known, Applied), JFrog Professional Services DevOps Engineer (known, Ineligible — US East Coast only), Lemon.io Senior DevOps Engineer (known/cross-board duplicate, Skipped — Golang/K8s gap). Out-of-family by title, not opened: Software Engineer and Security Operations Engineer (CircleCI), Engineering Manager, Notifications (Discord), Senior Software Engineer (CircleCI), Application Security Engineer II (Abnormal).

Platform Engineer: 4 results, reviewed. Complete. In-family hit: Proxify AB Senior Platform Engineer (known, New, score 4 — Kubernetes operator/Go gap). Out-of-family by title, not opened: Analytics Engineering Manager, Data Platform & Governance (LawnStarter, listed twice), Lead Engineer (Drupal / Web Platforms) (Current) — data-analytics management and CMS web development respectively, not infrastructure/DevOps.
Site Reliability Engineer: 0 results. Zero results — confirms the persistent multi-word-phrase gap on this site's search.
Cloud Engineer: 1 result, reviewed. Complete. Proxify AB Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure) — known, Ineligible (CET±3 timezone excludes Canada).
DevSecOps Engineer: 0 results. Zero results — confirms the persistent multi-word-phrase gap.
Forward Deployed Engineer: 1 result, reviewed. Complete. Databricks AI Engineer - FDE — known, Out of scope (application-layer GenAI, not infrastructure).
All 6 mandatory queries: Complete or Zero results — no CAPTCHA, block, or access failure encountered this run.

Net for this run: every posting surfaced across all 6 queries was already known from the 2026-09-21 run (same URLs) or clearly out of the SRE/Platform/DevOps family by title. Zero new candidates, zero new filings. This board's live inventory has not meaningfully turned over in the 24 hours since the last check.

method: Bare-title rotation per the check-wwr skill's six mandatory queries (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer), each searched independently via weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/search?term=. Eligibility gated on each posting's own detail-page location line, never the decorative "Anywhere in the World" tag. This run found no new inventory since 2026-09-21 — the same 7 in-family postings resurfaced under the same URLs, already reflected in applications.md and this report. Repository notes (job_sources.md) continue to show single-broad-term searches ("DevOps", "Cloud", "Platform") surfacing more volume historically than this skill's mandated bare-title rotation; the bare-title rotation was used here per the skill's written mandatory-query list.
